explanation: This is a Singleton, but the lazy-loading is not thread-safe; multiple threads may create multiple instances due to race condition.
This is double-checked locking: first check (no lock) for performance, second check (with lock) for thread-safety.
Strategy pattern encapsulates algorithms (payment methods) and makes them interchangeable at runtime.
Builder pattern constructs complex objects step by step with a fluent interface.
Observer pattern defines a one-to-many dependency where a subject notifies multiple observers of state changes.
This is an eager-loaded Singleton: the instance is created at class loading time, guaranteed thread-safe by JVM.
Factory pattern encapsulates object creation logic, decoupling client code from concrete classes.
Decorator pattern adds behavior to objects dynamically without modifying their structure.
Memento pattern captures and externalizes an object's state without violating encapsulation, enabling undo/redo.
Command pattern encapsulates requests as objects, allowing parameterization and queuing of commands.
